pose: Close-up headshot, angled three-quarters toward the camera, showing a wide, friendly smile with an open beak.

character_details.expression: Expressive, soulful large brown eyes with light catchlights, wide-open beak forming a warm, friendly smile.
character_details.coloration: Soft pastel pink downy 'feathers' covering the head and neck, transitioning to a smoother, leathery texture on the beak. Beak exterior is pastel pink.

beak_details.upper_jaw: Toothless, featuring a continuous, pronounced upward curve resembling an avocet.
beak_details.lower_jaw: Dense, clean, comb-like row of hundreds of incredibly fine, vertical white keratin filter bristles, rising uniformly toward the upper jaw. Clean, pristine, and free of any visible invertebrates or bugs.
beak_details.tip: Long, slender, and smooth, resolving with an elegant upward sweep.

environment.foreground: Shoreline with soft green Equisetites (giant horsetails) and clusters of small, friendly pink flowering plants.
environment.background: Dappled light on calm, clear turquoise lagoon water with sun-bleached limestone nodules, viewed in soft-focus depth.

setting_details.substrate: Fine white carbonate sand with salt crystals.
setting_details.sky: Intense, saturated blue, viewed indirectly through warm atmospheric light and distant hazy palm-like trees.

visual_logic: This headshot is designed to be child-friendly and inviting, prioritizing soft, appealing forms and clear expression. It features strict anatomical integration of the re-sculpted 'avocet' morphology for the upper jaw while maintaining the accurate filter-bristle battery in the lower jaw.
